title: sys_activity reads expand the parent-record read gate to one branch per registered object: a top=20 read for 3 objects becomes a 396 KB SQL statement with 1402 bindings, run twice (rows and count)
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 (the control plane's console open: 13 s to the last API response on staging, 30 calls with duplicates) cannot meet its acceptance (a splash under 4 s, a call budget) from cloud. The os-dev on that card measured one full console open on a local control plane at framework `f7e836da1ed3` / objectui `ef71a09f9e5f`, with Chromium and CDP initiator stacks mapped through source maps, on SQLite and on Postgres behind a 50 ms round trip (report `6225536289` on cloud#2914; every call's table is in the Attribution section of PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2941). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: the 142 most recent open objectstack issues hold one neighbour, objectstack-ai/objectstack#23980 (the home activity feed's `sys_activity` query answers 500 when the registry lists objects of an uninstalled app). It is a different symptom on, very likely, the same gate. This card is the cost half; whoever takes #23980 should read both.

## Measured (framework `f7e836da1ed3`)

**Every console open runs the notification bell's read,** `GET /data/sys_activity?top=20` filtered to 3 objects.

**That read becomes one SQL statement of 396 KB with 1402 bindings,** run twice (rows, then count). It costs 372 ms on SQLite with no network, and 866 ms at 50 ms RTT.

**The producer is `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts`.** It adds one branch per registered parent object (`:647`), not per object the read asks for.

## Done when

- **The gate intersects the parents it enumerates with the read's own `object_name` filter,** when the read has one. A read for 3 objects carries at most 3 branches.
- **A test pins the branch count** for a filtered read.

The file is unchanged on objectstack `main` `e246f06119`.

Dedupe words: parent-record-read-gate enumerates all objects, sys_activity large SQL, notification bell activity read, 1402 bindings.
